why_empty: No real invited tester session has taken place. Automation prepared the plan, the scripts and this log, but must not author feedback on behalf of a human or invent a tester observation. Every entry in this file must originate from an actual person completing an actual session.
how_to_add_an_entry: 1. Run a session against a single known build SHA.
2. Record the tester's own words for expected vs actual. Do not paraphrase into a conclusion.
3. Assign severity using the definitions in the schema; when in doubt, rate higher and let triage lower it.
4. Set status NEW. Only the triager moves it onward.
5. Confirm privacy_classification before attaching any screenshot.
note_on_automation_found_defects: Defects discovered by automation rather than by a tester are recorded separately in DEFECT_LOG.json so that real-user signal is never diluted with machine-found issues.
